papers.title_en: Task-Phase-Conditioned Expert Routing Is Not a Reliable Proxy for Quantization Sensitivity in MoE FFN Tensors
papers.evidence: 基于路由敏感度的MoE FFN张量逐层混合精度量化
papers.tldr: 本文检验MoE模型中按任务阶段采集的专家路由统计能否指导逐层混合精度量化。作者在ik_llama.cpp中为Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B构建路由采集流程，以路由熵、CV、Jaccard脆弱性和top-1强度构造敏感度分数，并用坐标下降在固定平均bpw下优化FFN层分配。在约4.0 bpw平坦、约2.7 bpw陡峭及随机对照实验中，路由引导重分配均未超过均匀基线；陡峭档随机分配与路由引导差距在1 SE内。结论是路由统计不是可靠的逐层量化敏感度代理。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether per-layer, per-task-phase (prompt/reasoning/response) expert-routing statistics in a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors (down/gate and up). To attain layerwise routing statistics, we build a routing-capture and profiling pipeline for Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B in ik_llama.cpp, derive a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy/decisiveness, coefficient of variation (CV), Jaccard/phase-fragility, and top-1 expert strength, and use coordinate descent to tune a layer allocation that respects a fixed average bits-per-weight budget. Notably, the profiling pipeline is applicable to standard top-k MoE architectures. Across independent experimental conditions (about 4.0 bpw flat, about 2.7 bpw steep, and about 2.7 bpw random allocation as a control), reallocation fails to outperform the uniform baseline within each quality tier. In the flat regime, reallocation is statistically neutral (z about 0.9). For the steep tier, the random reallocation performs within 1 SE of the routing-guided reallocation at the same tier, indicating a structural loss at this quality rung caused by mandatory downgrades and Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) tail injection. This aggressive-budget condition shows a decisive loss (z greater than 4 SE) replicated across three independent weight vectors. We argue that the deeper issue is that routing-behavior statistics are an unvalidated proxy for true per-layer quantization cost.

papers.title_en: Not All Frames Are Equal:Difference-Aware Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit ASR
papers.evidence: 基于GPTQ/AWQ Hessian加权的帧差异感知训练后量化校准
papers.tldr: 面向语音识别的超低比特（2-3比特）后训练量化会出现转写性能严重退化，原因是语音帧激活在稳态与零填充区高度相关、在音素边界快速变化，等权Hessian使静态帧主导校准。DiffAQ用帧间激活差分衡量声学变化速率，并按比例分配Hessian重要性，把量化精度集中到音素关键帧。作为GPTQ的无训练改造，它在多种Whisper规模与基准上稳定降低WER，2比特下提升最大，可缓解基线退化输出。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods such as GPTQ and AWQ compress large language models effectively, but applying them to automatic speech recognition (ASR) at ultra-low bit-widths (2-3 bits) causes severe transcription degradation. Unlike discrete text tokens, speech activations are highly correlated in steady-state and zero-padded regions yet change rapidly at phonetic boundaries; when all frames contribute equally to the Hessian, static frames dominate calibration and obscure informative transitions. We propose DiffAQ, which computes frame-to-frame activation differences to measure the rate of acoustic change and assigns Hessian importance proportionally, concentrating quantization precision on phonetically critical frames. As a training-free modification to GPTQ, DiffAQ consistently reduces WER across various Whisper sizes and standard benchmarks, with the largest gains at 2-bit precision where baseline methods frequently produce degenerate outputs.
